items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That was Lewis DeRux. Lewis was his name. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. He played in the old Eureka and Excelsa bands.

ctx.x: My full name is Dolly Marie Adams.
And what was your name before you were married? Dolly DeRux. DeRux. So you were a daughter of one of Professor Mineta's sisters.
That's right. My mother, which is Professor Mineta's sister, she was also a musician.
